title: From a Windowed Square Wave to the Hyperbolic Tangent, Even Zeta Values, and Dirichlet L-Values
summary: We window a delayed periodic square wave with a decaying signum function and evaluate the product at zero frequency in both the time and frequency domains. The window renders every series that appears absolutely convergent, so the argument requires only elementary integrals and a limit. We obtain new unified derivations for the Mittag-Leffler partial-fraction expansion for the hyperbolic tangent, the Fourier expansion of the first Euler polynomial E1, and the Basel sum, zeta(2).
